name: Greenland
about: Jun–Aug is when boat tours to the calving Ilulissat Icefjord run and hiking is possible; Nov–Mar is aurora and dog-sledding season, genuinely harsher and far more limited.
overview: The world's largest island, mostly ice sheet, with towns reachable only by boat or plane — no roads connect them.
costOverview: Greenland has no cheap version — even a casual inexpensive meal runs into real money, and a boat tour among the icebergs is the one splurge nearly every visitor to Ilulissat budgets for.

stargazing.label: Aurora season (dark enough to see it)

specialSeasons.text: The only reliable window for boat tours into the Ilulissat Icefjord, plus 24-hour midnight sun in the north.
Dog sledding and aurora hunting are the main draw — genuinely harsh conditions, and most settlements are far more isolated.
